wiki.title: Brandon Guffey
wiki.extract: Brandon Guffey (born January 29, 1980) is an American politician of the Republican Party in South Carolina. He served for many years as a precinct president over his local precinct along with being president of his HOA. He is currently a member of the South Carolina House of Representatives representing District 48.
